Protocol 1000+ - Bath

Protocol mms miracle-mineral-solution bath transdermal sodium-chlorite

Evidence: Grade C (traditional_use)

Summary

MMS bath protocol using sodium chlorite solution added to bath water for transdermal absorption (MMS-1000+). Suitable for those who prefer not to ingest MMS orally.

Indications

  • skin-conditions
  • detoxification
  • general-wellness

Contraindications

  • severe-skin-sensitivity
  • open-wounds

Dosage

20-60 drops activated MMS solution added to warm bath water, soak 20-30 minutes (MMS-1000+). DMSO added from day 2-3 if needed.

Frequency: 1-3 times daily
